messages.author: d096edb922462595
messages.subject: Fscores breaking
parts:
Phil,

The new version introduced some errors into fscores. In the past, fscores could predict scores of mirt models, or work with new response patterns. This is now breaking with

 fscores(irt_model)
Error in grepl("PHI", x@parnames) : 
  no slot of name "parnames" for this object of class "GroupPars"

Model is attached. Seems like a bug?

thanks,
Tobi

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Fscores breaking
parts:
Hi Tobias,

Oddly enough, the model looks fine to me when I extract-out the data from the object and fit the same model:

library(mirt)
dat <- extract.mirt(irt_model, 'data')
mod <- mirt(dat, 1)
fscores(mod)

Did this portion in your syntax give an object that looked the same as the dat object above? Or, perhaps your mirt 1.28.7 is slightly different than mine (there have been serveral commits with that version number...I'm rather lazy when it comes to text version increments with git).

data.frame(lapply(treatment_back[, questions], as.numeric))

Phil
